title: Build a Todo List
prompt:
Build a simple todo list in this project's existing files.

**Entry:** Preview opens `index.html` first — put the main UI there (and `style.css` / `main.js`). Extra HTML pages are fine if you link to them from the home page.

Requirements:

- Lets you add a new todo from a text input
- Shows all todos in a list
- Lets you mark a todo as done / not done
- Lets you delete a todo
- Persists todos in localStorage so they survive a refresh

Vanilla JS or CDN only — no Vite/npm. You're done when you can add, toggle, and delete todos, and they still appear after refreshing Preview.
